version.description: etcd version (X.Y.Z) to run, set on the EtcdCluster's spec.version; the operator pulls etcd from its own configured image.

storageClass.description: StorageClass used to store the data.

affinity.description: Affinity rules set verbatim on the EtcdCluster's spec.affinity, replacing the chart default. When left empty the chart applies a soft (preferred) podAntiAffinity by kubernetes.io/hostname on top of the topologySpreadConstraints, which by default require an even spread of members over nodes (whenUnsatisfiable DoNotSchedule, maxSkew 1) unless the platform sets scheduling.globalAppTopologySpreadConstraints. The anti-affinity stays soft because a required rule forbids two members on one node even when every node already has one, so an etcd with more members than schedulable nodes could not start all of them. Set a requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution rule here only on clusters with at least as many schedulable nodes as members. With node-local storage a recreated member Pod can only return to its own node, so a required rule keeps it Pending while that node holds another member, and the default spread does the same once some other node holds none. The operator copies affinity into each EtcdMember when it creates the member and builds every Pod of that member from that copy, so a change does not reschedule running members and takes effect only as members are replaced by new ones.
